  > - Original cells, smooth pool: the true M never reaches 0.90 (0.895); the block reading does not replicate. Say "mixed across the two sources, leaning to the cubic M̂ on the block"; do not say the price is only M̂ noise.
  > - (b)/(e): no curvature bound reaches 0.90 with the true M (0.59); cubic reaches it at 6.7× only through noise. Pooled "all but (d)" true M: not reached (0.846).
  > - Do not state a price for non-identification. The claim the arm supports: the cost depends on the class of assumption (right class and bound: cheap on smooth responses; wrong class: no width of that class helps; estimated bound: width is noise). Exploratory, arms use the truth or a null column.
  > `paper-repo` already has the block/original κ* reading; the lean arm is dropped as not usable.
